description: This file defines a singleton class AgentEventStore that manages a collection of ControlAgentEvent instances, allowing appending and clearing events. It uses Swift's properties and methods, along with Swift concurrency features like @MainActor.

classes.name: AgentEventStore
classes.description: A singleton class that stores and manages a list of ControlAgentEvent objects with a maximum capacity.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new event to the events list, and removes oldest events if exceeding maxEvents.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all stored events from the store.
